title: Tennis Championship
statementMd:
Famous Brazil city Rio de Janeiro holds a tennis tournament and Ostap Bender doesn't want to miss this event. There will be $*n*$ players participating, and the tournament will follow knockout rules from the very first game. That means, that if someone loses a game he leaves the tournament immediately.

Organizers are still arranging tournament grid (i.e. the order games will happen and who is going to play with whom) but they have already fixed one rule: two players can play against each other only if the number of games one of them has already played **differs by no more than one** from the number of games the other one has already played. Of course, both players had to win all their games in order to continue participating in the tournament.

Tournament hasn't started yet so the audience is a bit bored. Ostap decided to find out what is the maximum number of games the winner of the tournament can take part in (assuming the rule above is used). However, it is unlikely he can deal with this problem without your help.

## Input

The only line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$) — the number of players to participate in the tournament.

## Output

Print the maximum number of games in which the winner of the tournament can take part.

## Note

In all samples we consider that player number $1$ is the winner.

In the first sample, there would be only one game so the answer is $1$.

In the second sample, player $1$ can consequently beat players $2$ and $3$.

In the third sample, player $1$ can't play with each other player as after he plays with players $2$ and $3$ he can't play against player $4$, as he has $0$ games played, while player $1$ already played $2$. Thus, the answer is $2$ and to achieve we make pairs $(1, 2)$ and $(3, 4)$ and then clash the winners.
statementZhMd:
著名的巴西城市里约热内卢举办了一场网球锦标赛，奥斯塔普·本德尔不想错过这项赛事。将有 $*n*$ 名选手参赛，锦标赛从第一场比赛开始就遵循淘汰赛规则。这意味着，如果某位选手输掉一场比赛，他就会立即被淘汰出局。

组织者仍在安排锦标赛的赛程（即比赛进行的顺序以及选手之间的对阵关系），但他们已经确定了一条规则：只有当两名选手此前参加过的比赛场数之差不超过一场时，他们才能彼此对战。当然，两名选手都必须赢下此前参加的所有比赛，才能继续留在锦标赛中。

锦标赛尚未开始，因此观众们有些无聊。奥斯塔普决定 выяснить，在使用上述规则的情况下，锦标赛冠军最多可以参加多少场比赛。不过，如果没有你的帮助，他恐怕很难解决这个问题。

## 输入

输入仅包含一行，其中包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$）——参赛选手的数量。

## 输出

输出锦标赛冠军最多可以参加的比赛场数。

## 说明

在所有样例中，我们都认为编号为 $1$ 的选手是冠军。

在第一个样例中，只有一场比赛，因此答案为 $1$。

在第二个样例中，选手 $1$ 可以依次击败选手 $2$ 和选手 $3$。

在第三个样例中，选手 $1$ 无法与其他每一名选手进行比赛：在他与选手 $2$ 和选手 $3$ 比赛后，他无法再与选手 $4$ 对战，因为选手 $4$ 参加过 $0$ 场比赛，而选手 $1$ 已经参加过 $2$ 场比赛。因此，答案是 $2$。为了达到这一结果，可以先进行配对 $(1, 2)$ 和 $(3, 4)$，然后让两场比赛的胜者进行对决。
